# spendtron

> spendtron prices GitHub Actions jobs at current per-runner rates. Load GitHub's detailed usage report for a chart with no account; it is read in the browser and not uploaded. Connect the GitHub App for a live sample and a pull request. The chart and the pull requests are free.

## Connect

- MCP endpoint (streamable HTTP): https://spendtron.com/mcp
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <API key>`. The key is shown once after installing the GitHub App at https://spendtron.com/github/install
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http spendtron https://spendtron.com/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"`

## Tools

- `check_workflow_yaml`: arguments `yaml` (one workflow file) and optional `visibility` (`public` or `private`). No API key needed. A static cost review covering duplicate triggers, missing concurrency, path filters and timeouts, macOS and larger runners, matrix width, frequent schedules and missing caches. Returns findings and a patched copy with the safe fixes applied. Nothing is stored. The same check is available over HTTP: `POST https://spendtron.com/api/check-workflow` with JSON `{"yaml": "...", "visibility": "private"}`.
- `check_actions_cost`: no arguments; needs the API key. Returns the saved report: workflows priced per job at current runner rates, plus corroborated changes. It does not scan GitHub. Open `/report` once to build the sample.

## Free web tools

- Workflow cost checker: https://spendtron.com/tools/workflow-checker
- GitHub Actions cost calculator: https://spendtron.com/tools/github-actions-cost-calculator
- Self-hosted vs GitHub-hosted break-even: https://spendtron.com/tools/self-hosted-runner-cost
- Larger runner calculator: https://spendtron.com/tools/larger-runner-calculator

## Access and pricing

- Load a detailed usage report at `/` or `/audit`. With JavaScript it is parsed in the browser and never sent to the server.
- GitHub App: Actions read, Metadata read, Contents, Pull requests, and Workflows read and write. Write is used only when you submit the pull-request button. A shared report link cannot open pull requests.
- The chart, the sample, and those pull requests are free. A written audit is quoted separately when the figure is about $200 or more.
- In-repo action: `swantron/spendtron/github-action`.
